member.name: T:HMS.Modules.Products.Domain.Product
member.summary: The product/item master (docs/04_Product_Management_ERD, "Core Product") — the aggregate root every other entity in this module (barcodes, batches, prices, images, attribute values, tax mappings) belongs to via a plain product_id FK. Classification and unit fields (, , , ...) are FK-only references into the Masters module's schema — modeled as plain columns (no EF navigation) since the target types live in a different module/assembly. Referential validity against Masters is checked at the Application layer via Masters' public I{Entity}Service seam, not via a database-level cross-schema constraint alone.

member.name: M:HMS.Modules.Products.Endpoints.ProductsController.RedactCostPrice(HMS.Modules.Products.Contracts.ProductResponse)
member.summary: pharmacy.view alone (the gate on both actions above) grants list/detail visibility to every day-to-day dispensing user — CostPrice (procurement cost) is commercially sensitive margin data on top of that, so it's zeroed out here unless the caller separately holds pharmacy.view-cost (ADR-077). A plain 0 rather than a nullable field: ProductResponse.CostPrice is a non-nullable decimal used identically by both create/edit forms (which always have the real value) and this read path, and changing its nullability would be a wider contract change than this fix warrants — 0 is already how an uncosted product reads elsewhere in this codebase (see update-diagnostic-cost-prices.ps1's identical "not yet costed" convention).

member.name: T:HMS.Modules.Products.Infrastructure.ProductsDbContext
member.summary: Owns the "products" PostgreSQL schema — the product/item catalog and its child records (barcodes, batches, prices, images, dynamic attributes, tax mappings), per docs/04_Product_Management_ERD. Per docs/DatabaseArchitecture.md §1, only this module's own code constructs/migrates this context — no other module references it. Some of this module's own tables carry foreign keys into the Masters module's schema (see ProductConfiguration); those are modeled as plain columns, never as EF navigations into Masters' internal domain types.

member.name: T:HMS.Modules.Products.ProductsModule
member.summary: Single composition entry point for this module, called once from HMS.Api/Configuration — mirrors HMS.Modules.Masters.MastersModule. Product Management depends on the Masters module's public service seam (registered by AddMastersModule) for classification/unit reference validation — HMS.Api's ModuleRegistration must call AddMastersModule before AddProductsModule.
